data.name: LogManagementDescription
data.value: Configure how long local records and log files are kept.

data.name: Explanation
data.value: Statistics are retained separately from detailed history and audit records. Size and count limits can prune older data before its day limit. Data older than a configured limit is removed when you apply changes. Applying settings does not restart or delete current requests or executions.

data.name: LoadFailed
data.value: Could not load the saved retention settings. Defaults are shown; applying changes requires confirmation.

data.name: DefaultsNotice
data.value: Default values are shown. Select Apply to save them.

data.name: WholeNumberError
data.value: Enter a whole number for each setting.

data.name: RangeError
data.value: One or more values are outside the allowed range.

data.name: ConfirmMessage
data.value: Lower retention or capacity limits can permanently remove older stored data. Data older than the new limits may be deleted when these settings are applied. Current requests and executions will continue without restart or deletion.

data.name: ApplyFailed
data.value: Could not apply retention settings. Your current values remain on screen.

data.name: ApplyUnavailable
data.value: Retention settings cannot be applied right now.

data.name: SavedCleanupPending
data.value: Settings were saved, but some logs could not be cleaned up. Cleanup will be retried automatically.
